results.raw: False. Belize Consolidated Laws are not published by the Attorney General; the official revised edition is issued under the authority of the Law Revision Commissioner.
False. Belize Court of Appeal Judgments is not an official publisher; the decision is an official court record, not a commercially published source.
False. Belize Supreme Court Judgments is not an official publisher; the cited decision appears to be a non-official or fabricated source.
False. The Central Bank of Belize (Amendment) Act No. 8 of 2018 was enacted by Belize’s Parliament, not published by the Central Bank itself.
False. The 2026 date is future-dated; no such amendment can have been published in 2026.
False. The date 2026-01-01 is in the future, so the SI cannot have been published.
False. Belize Consolidated Laws (Attorney General) is not an official publisher; Cap 67 is the Banana Industry (Special Powers) Act, not a loan act.
False. The decision is a Belize Court of Appeal judgment; Mexico’s SCJN Open Data Platform only publishes Mexican federal rulings, not Belizean cases.
False. Belize Supreme Court Judgments is not an official publisher; the cited decision appears to be a non-official or fabricated source.
False. The Central Bank of Belize (Amendment) Act No. 8 of 2018 is a Belizean statute; it cannot be an official publication of Honduras’s Tribunal Superior de Cuentas.
False. Belize has no "Mexico Orden Juridico Nacional"; the cited 2026 Act cannot be published by a Mexican source.
False. Belize statutory instruments are not published by Mexico’s Orden Jurídico Nacional; the cited source is implausible for a Belizean SI.
